_comment: Config for runners/run_downstream_final.py (original HMC downstream tasks).
feature_sets: each entry runs end-to-end for every task and method and
becomes a row level in the results table, so several preprocessing
variants can be compared in one run. Keys:
source        'X' (the count matrix) or 'obsm' with a 'key'
normalization one of NORMALIZATIONS in downstream_final_utils.py:
'none', 'l2', 'clr', 'log', 'rel_ab' -- same names and
semantics as the earlier normalization script
prevalence_threshold / abundance_threshold
optional feature filter applied to raw counts BEFORE
normalization: keep features non-zero in at least this
fraction of samples and with at least this mean count.
Computed over train and test together, as before.
Only 'raw' is active; _feature_sets_examples below shows the shape for
later experiments. The h5ads currently expose no .obsm keys, so obsm
sources only work once embeddings are written there.
split_mode: 'auto' counts distinct obs['study_id'] across the task's rows --
one study means pool train+test and run nested CV, more than one means
keep the existing split. That routes location and sex to presplit and
everything else to combined_cv. Override only to depart from that.
Dropped relative to configs/downstream_tasks.json: 'age' and 'bmi'
(continuous, and regression is no longer run) and 'random_forest'.
cv.min_samples_per_class defaults to outer_folds (5), the point below which
stratification cannot put a class in every fold -- that is a hard
constraint, not a quality threshold, so nothing above it is filtered.
Raise it per task to trade classes for tighter error bars.

location._comment: 12 train / 7 test studies, disjoint -> presplit cross-study holdout

sex._comment: 3 train / 2 test studies, disjoint -> presplit cross-study holdout

hbv_infection._comment: PRJNA382861 only; hbv 206 / nafld 31 / healthy 26, 263 pooled

_comment: PRJNA559803 only; 235 samples pooled. extraction_control is a negative
control (3 samples), not a treatment arm -- excluded explicitly rather
than left to be silently dropped by the rare-class filter.

crohns_disease._comment: PRJNA450540 only; 227 pooled but only 22 controls -- imbalanced

hiv_infection._comment: PRJDB10485 only; binary and balanced, 109 samples pooled

_comment: PRJNA650259 only, and by far the smallest task: 36 samples pooled,
23 negative / 13 positive. Both classes clear the stratification floor,
but each outer fold tests on only ~7 samples -- read its error margin as
very wide rather than precise.
